title: Password field stored as plain text
description: Security rule — normal (stored) fields whose name suggests a password / PIN. Unless the file has Encryption at rest (EAR) enabled, FileMaker stores field values unencrypted. The "Encryption at rest" column shows each file's EAR status.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Without Encryption at rest, a stored password field is readable by anyone with file access or a backup.
rule.remediation: Store only a salted hash, delegate authentication to FileMaker accounts / an external IdP, and enable Encryption at rest.
